name: @corbits-builder/designer
description: Designs how an interface could look, such as a web app, a mobile app's screens, a dashboard or a marketing page, as clickable mockups the person compares, tries and approves, and lets the person choose its fonts and colours.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The person wants to see how something they are making could look, to try or approve a design, or to choose its fonts or colours.
builder.unless: They want something already built changed in a way they already stated exactly.
examples: make me a mockup for a dog-walking app
design the screens for my phone app
mock up a landing page for my product
show me a few different looks
can I see what it would look like
I want to give feedback on the design
the design looks good, approve it
can we use a different typeface
I'm not sure about the font, what else could work
the writing looks boring, can it be more elegant
make it look like a newspaper with a serif
can we make it less orange
I don't know which colour would suit us

facts.design_chosen: the person chose a design from the design options

looks.label: Modern and sleek
looks.direction: Crisp cool neutrals, one cobalt accent, generous whitespace, system sans-serif type and subtle depth.

looks.label: Rounded enterprise
looks.direction: Friendly large radii (--radius about 1rem), a calm mid-blue primary and soft cool greys.

looks.label: Boxy enterprise
looks.direction: Square corners (--radius 0), a deep navy primary and a sober, high-contrast palette of near-black text on white with hairline grey borders.

looks.label: Dark and technical
looks.direction: A dark canvas in both :root and .dark (near-black background, slate cards), a neon cyan primary and --font-sans set to ui-monospace, monospace.

looks.label: Bold and colourful
looks.direction: Saturated colour: an electric magenta primary, bright yellow secondary and cyan accent on a white background.

looks.label: Liquid glass
looks.direction: iOS-like frosted surfaces with background blur over vivid solid colour fields blurred into soft light, fluid curves and system type.

looks.label: Pastel and soft
looks.direction: Muted pastel tints for the primary, secondary and accent, an off-white background, gentle contrast and large radii (--radius about 1rem).

looks.label: Editorial
looks.direction: Magazine-like: --font-sans set to ui-serif, Georgia, serif, an ink-black primary on a warm off-white background and restrained colour.

looks.label: Warm and organic
looks.direction: Earthy tones: a terracotta or olive primary, a cream background, soft brown borders and --font-sans set to Optima, Candara, "Segoe UI", sans-serif.

looks.label: Minimal monochrome
looks.direction: Black, white and greys only: a near-black primary with white text on it, grey secondary and accent.

looks.label: Retro
looks.direction: A nostalgic cream, tomato, mustard and teal palette, chunky ink outlines, 70s display type and tactile, toy-like controls.

looks.label: Dense trading desk
looks.direction: For experts: a dark slate canvas in both :root and .dark, a muted blue primary, small radii (--radius 0.25rem), and --success and --destructive kept for gains and losses.

looks.label: Enthusiast forum
looks.direction: A long-running hobby forum: a faded navy primary on parchment, small radii (--radius 0.25rem) and --font-sans set to "Arial Narrow", "Roboto Condensed", sans-serif.

look.font-primary.about: The font for headings and text.

look.font-secondary.about: The font for code and figures.

look.color-primary.about: The brand colour of buttons and links.
